title: Noise stability of odd majorities
statement: For every integer $m\ge 0$ and every correlation parameter $0<\rho<1$, the noise stability of majority on $2m+3$ coordinates is strictly less than that of majority on $2m+1$ coordinates, where noise stability is computed under the correlated pair distribution with correlation parameter $\rho$.
